lines.rom: jaya brahma jaya svayambhu caturanana sukhamula karahu krpa nija dasa pai rahahu sada anukula
tuma srjaka brahmanda ke aja vidhi dhata nama visvavidhata kijiye jana pai krpa lalama
jaya jaya kamalasana jagamula rahahu sada janapai anukula
rupa caturbhuja parama suhavana tumhem ahaim caturdika anana
raktavarna tava subhaga sarira mastaka jatajuta gambhira
take upara mukuta birajai darhi sveta mahachavi chajai
svetavastra dhare tuma sundara hai yajnopavita ati manahara
kanana kundala subhaga birajahim gala motina ki mala rajahim
carihu veda tumhim pragataye divya jnana tribhuvanahim sikhaye
brahmaloka subha dhama tumhara akhila bhuvana maham yasa bistara
arddhamgini tava hai savitri apara nama hiye gayatri
sarasvati taba suta manohara vina vadini saba vidhi sundara
kamalasana para rahe biraje tuma haribhakti saja saba saje
ksira sindhu sovata surabhupa nabhi kamala bho pragata anupa
tehi para tuma asina krpala sada karahu santana pratipala
eka bara ki katha pracari tuma kaham moha bhayeu mana bhari
kamalasana lakhi kinha bicara aura na kou ahai samsara
taba tuma kamalanala gahi linha anta bilokana kara prana kinha
kotika varsa gaye yahi bhamti bhramata bhramata bite dina rati
pai tuma takara anta na paye hvai nirasa atisaya duhkhiyaye
puni bicara mana maham yaha kinha mahapadma yaha ati pracina
yako janma bhayo ko karana tabahim mohi karayo yaha dharana
akhila bhuvana maham kaham koi nahim saba kachu ahai nihita mo mahim
yaha niscaya kari garaba barhayo nija kaham brahma mani sukhapaye
gagana gira taba bhai gambhira brahma vacana sunahu dhari dhira
sakala srsti kara svami joi brahma anadi alakha hai soi
nija iccha una saba niramaye brahma visnu mahesa banaye
srsti lagi pragate trayadeva saba jaga inaki karihai seva
mahapadma jo tumharo asana ta pai ahai visnu ko sasana
visnu nabhitem pragatyo ai tuma kaham satya dinha samujhai
bhaimtahu jai visnu hitamani yaha kahi banda bhai nabhavani
tahi sravana kahi acaraja mana puni caturanana kinha payana
kamala nala dhari nice ava taham visnu ke darsana pava
sayana karata dekhe surabhupa syamavarna tanu parama anupa
sohata caturbhuja atisundara kritamukata rajata mastaka para
gala baijanti mala birajai koti surya ki sobha lajai
samkha cakra aru gada manohara padma sahita ayudha saba sundara
payam palotati rama nirantara sesa naga sayya ati manahara
divyarupa lakhi kinha pranamu harsita bhe sripati sukha dhamu
bahu vidhi vinaya kinha caturanana taba laksmi pati kaheu mudita mana
brahma duri karahu abhimana brahmarupa hama dou samana
tije sri sivasankara ahim brahmarupa saba tribhuvana mamhim
tuma som hoi srsti vistara hama palana karihaim samsara
siva samhara karahim saba kera hama tinahum kaham kaja dhanera
agunarupa sri brahma bakhanahu nirakara tinakaham tuma janahu
hama sakara rupa trayadeva karihaim sada brahma ki seva
yaha suni brahma parama sihaye parabrahma ke yasa ati gaye
so saba vidita veda ke nama mukti rupa so parama lalama
yahi vidhi prabhu bho janama tumhara puni tuma pragata kinha samsara
nama pitamaha sundara payeu jara cetana saba kaham niramayeu
linha aneka bara avatara sundara suyasa jagata vistara
devadanuja saba tuma kaham dhyavahim manavamchita tuma sana saba pavahim
jo kou dhyana dharai nara nari taki asa pujavahu sari
puskara tirtha parama sukhadai taham tuma basahu sada surarai
kunda nahai karahi jo pujana ta kara dura hoi saba dusana
